title: Are AIPAC and Haley Stevens... Working Together?
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
In Michigan, AIPAC is going to great lengths to help pro-Israel Senate
candidate **Haley Stevens** defeat her progressive opponent, **Abdul El-
Sayed** , in the state's Democratic primary, with the group already spending
around [$30 million](https://www.cbsnews.com/detroit/news/aipac-michigan-
senate-primary-stevens-abdul-el-sayed/) backing her, the most they've ever
spent on a single race.

But the AIPAC support doesn't stop there.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

As **Mehdi** breaks down in this **4-minute video** , AIPAC's super PAC -
United Democracy Project - has been running ads with the exact kind of
messages Haley Stevens has been asking for, despite campaign finance laws
[prohibiting coordination](https://campaignlegal.org/update/super-pacs-cant-
coordinate-candidates-heres-what-happened-when-one-did) between super PACs and
their preferred candidate.

**Watch the full video above** where Mehdi brings the receipts, unpacks the
concept of 'redboxing,' and explains how AIPAC and Stevens might be getting
away with it.
